title: Savings goals
description: Set savings goals and put dollars aside toward each one in a deposit account.
goal_template: A savings goals app on a deposit account, such as a money market account. Customers open the account, create goals with a name, a target amount and a date, add money toward a goal from their bank account, and see each goal's progress. Show the account's terms, its interest rate and fees exactly as the product's offer states them, the amount before each transfer, and every document the product requires before the customer agrees. The app shows information, not advice.

screens.title: Goals
screens.purpose: Each goal with its target, date and progress, from the account's balance and the lifecycle events api/ receives on Mynt's webhook.

screens.title: New goal
screens.purpose: Name a goal, its target and its date. The goal's details are saved to Mynt's vault (saveFields) after consent, never to the app's own database.

screens.title: Open an account
screens.purpose: Opening the deposit account the goals draw on: the product's journey, with its consents, documents and the provider's hosted identity checks.

screens.title: Add to a goal
screens.purpose: Add dollars from the customer's bank account toward a goal: the amount and any fee shown first, then the provider's hosted flow.

screens.title: Account terms
screens.purpose: The account's terms, interest rate, fees and limits as the product's offer states them, and its required documents shown verbatim.

flows.title: Create the first goal
steps: open the account with the product's journey if the customer has none
ask for consent, then save the goal's name, target and date with saveFields
show the goal with no progress yet and an Add money button

flows.title: Add money to a goal
steps: read the offer (offers) for the account's terms, rate, fees and limits
show the amount and any fee before the customer confirms
start the provider's hosted funding flow (startAction) and send the customer to its redirect_url
api/ records the outcome from Mynt's webhook (verifyWebhook); the goal's progress updates
